rules.from: In 2123, before submitting the winter ration plan, he recounted the grain stock three times, and proposed to the Free City Council that part of the sub-workshop's parts payments be accepted in seed.
2123년에는 겨울 배급안을 올리기 전 곡물 재고를 세 차례 다시 세었고, 분공방 부품 대금 일부를 종자로 받자고 자유도시 평의회에 제안하였다.
Jeong Ilhwan dies amid the conflict over succession approval in the family, leaving behind his only daughter, Jeong Seoon.
rules.to: Jeong Ilhwan dies, leaving behind his only daughter, Jeong Seoon.

rules.from: 정일환은 가문의 후계 인준 갈등 속에 외동딸 정서온을 남기고 사망한다.
